text:
maria: dropping a quick UX check-in for the routing editor mock. current layout shows a left rail with tools, center canvas, and a right-side overview map. on slimmer windows rule names are clipped and the layout feels tight. screenshot: https://mock.redwood/dev/policy-overview-compact.png

jon: yep saw that. the overview map is eating vertical room. can we convert it to a collapsible strip or an on-demand overlay? avoids constant shrinking of cards. :leaning_in_face:

ashley: i'd prefer a micro-legend above the canvas (single-line) that expands into the full overview when tapped. keeps key info visible but saves space.

kevin: a11y: the overview needs keyboard affordances. if it's overlay/toggle, ensure the toggle is reachable and the overlay traps focus while open. add `role=region` + an accessible label. also visible focus ring for the expand control.

sam: validation UX: preview runs show rule failures as ephemeral notices. users miss them. suggestion: attach a compact error indicator to the rule card (with tooltip explaining failure) and a sticky banner in the toolbar until all errors are cleared.

maria: agree. and for reordering: right now only drag handles. keyboard-only users must have explicit move controls. show small "▲" / "▼" buttons when a card is focused (visually hidden otherwise).

jon: move buttons should be in the card header and exposed to screen readers. also add a context menu with "Move to top/bottom" actions for big jumps.

ashley: copy note: change preview CTA from "Simulate traffic" to "Run routing simulation" and add contextual tooltip: "Preview routing outcomes for current policy configuration." makes intent clearer.

kevin: color contrast: error chips use our mid-red which fails AA at 14px. bump to a darker red and verify contrast in the theme tokens. also include high-contrast mode checks in the QA pass.

sam: visual behavior: when dragging rules the overview map re-centers aggressively. that's distracting. options: freeze updates during drag or show a semi-transparent ghost representation of the rule in the map.

maria: let's prototype freeze-first and throttled-update versions. ashley take compact legend + expansion; jon add keyboard flows and context menu; kevin outline aria attributes and contrast fixes; sam list validation scenarios and banner copy. i'll iterate the mock and post new link later today.

design-bot: Task created: "POLICY-UI: overview-map toggle & a11y + keyboard reorder" (EPIC-3482).

jon: small UX nit: focus order should progress toolbar -> canvas -> micro-legend -> inspector. current tab stops jump into inspector skipping canvas controls.

ashley: noted. i'll include focus order diagrams in the prototype.

kevin: ping me after the update and i'll run a quick axe run and keyboard checklist.

sam: i'll plug the new error states into the preview harness so we can rerun regression sims.

maria: thanks all. will reopen thread with updated screens and a short walkthrough video. closing for now.
